local_modifications.changes: Editing contract, source fidelity, protected content, saving and temporary-file rules, matching editable-prose normalization inputs, runtime guidance, and output references.
Source-supported title and heading review; editorial judgments remain separate from detector categories.
Display name, description, and prompt aligned with the local editing scope; explicit invocation retained.
Direct Claude Code and Codex installs, optional shared checkout in any directory, package ownership, portable verification, maintenance, and attribution; detector links pinned to canonical import.

Protected-region fixes for frontmatter and code, mapping-style frontmatter recognition that keeps thematic-break prose editable, path preservation, exact tracker carveouts, and CLI diagnostics; API and browser compatibility retained.
Whitespace-only cleanup of imported package text; license and attribution notice retained byte for byte.
Dependency-free Node verification and native regression tests, with package-relative paths, relocation checks, damaged-package failures, and no assistant settings or home-directory mutation.
